hero.title: VILLA R.E.E.L

features.title: Between alpine elegance and tropical atmosphere

villa.descriptionBody: Between mountains and lush garden, Villa R.E.E.L offers multiple living spaces, a heated pool, a tropical garden and unobstructed views of the alpine range. A place designed for families, team retreats and intimate events.

entreprises.title: Corporate & Seminars
entreprises.subtitle: Give your teams an inspiring setting between Alps and tropical garden for seminars, workshops, product launches and team-building activities.
entreprises.formulesTitle: Imagine your professional highlights at Villa R.E.E.L

formule.desc: A warm setting for work sessions, creative workshops or inspiring presentations, with flexible indoor and outdoor spaces.

why1.title: A haven outside the office
why1.desc: Far from anonymous meeting rooms, a character house that fosters informal exchange, creativity and team spirit.

why2.title: Indoor & outdoor spaces
why2.desc: Living room, terrace, tropical garden and pool alternately become work, sharing or relaxation settings.

why3.title: Tailor-made partners
why3.desc: Catering, wine tasting, photography and event management services can be added according to your needs.

entreprises.ctaTitle: Plan your next seminar at Villa R.E.E.L
entreprises.ctaDesc: Share your project, dates and needs, and we will get back to you with a tailor-made proposal.

evenements.title: Events & celebrations
evenements.subtitle: Engagements, intimate weddings, birthdays, bachelor/bachelorette parties... Villa R.E.E.L becomes the backdrop for your most precious moments.

event1.title: Engagements
event1.desc: An intimate setting to celebrate your engagement surrounded by loved ones, between a warm living room and a green terrace.

event2.title: Weddings
event2.desc: A character house for a confidential wedding, where every space can be staged for your special day.

event3.title: Birthdays
event3.desc: An unforgettable birthday in a warm villa, with pool, tropical garden and carefully crafted lighting.

event4.title: Bachelor/Bachelorette
event4.desc: A chic and relaxed setting for a weekend with friends, between relaxation, games and evenings by the pool.

evenements.servicesSubtitle: Compose your event with our trusted partners, according to your wishes and budget.

service1.title: Private chef
service1.desc: Custom menus, food & wine pairings, brunches, cocktail dinners...

service2.title: Wine tasting with ViniLux
service2.desc: Wine selections, tasting workshops and food pairings around your meals.

service3.title: Decoration & scenography
service3.desc: Floral atmosphere, lighting design, table decoration and overall scenography.

service4.title: Photography & video
service4.desc: Professional capture of your event for lasting memories.

service5.title: Music & ambiance
service5.desc: DJs, live musicians, playlists and sound system tailored to your wishes.

service6.title: Event coordination
service6.desc: Support to orchestrate service providers and the flow of your day.

evenements.ctaTitle: Ready to imagine your event at Villa R.E.E.L?
evenements.ctaDesc: Share your project, wishes and ideal date. We will get back to you to build a tailor-made proposal.

galerie.title: Gallery
galerie.subtitle: Discover the villa in pictures: interiors, outdoors, pool, bedrooms and living spaces.

collaborateurs.title: Our Partners
collaborateurs.subtitle: Trusted partners to enrich your stay: wine tasting, gastronomy, bespoke experiences.

vinilux.name: ViniLux
vinilux.desc: Wine merchant and oenological partner, ViniLux offers wine selections, tasting workshops and food pairings for your evenings, seminars or private events at the villa.

chef.name: Félicien Christe
chef.desc: Private chef, Félicien Christe creates personalised menus, intimate dinners, brunches and cocktail dinners for your stays and events at Villa R.E.E.L.
chef.note: On request, he can work for your private stays, corporate events or special celebrations.

collaborateurs.disclaimer: These services are optional and independent of the villa rental price. They are subject to separate quotes and invoicing from each service provider.
